subject: IDS 2026 — Israel LCV dealer compare v1.5 (map)
body:
Dear colleague,

Please find attached the IDS 2026 dealer compare pack for Israel LCV (v1.5).

What is included
• HTML: IDS_2026_dealer_compare_Israel_LCV.html
• Zip: IDS_2026_Israel_LCV_v1.5.zip
• Scope: Israel LCV dealers only (29) — other countries are not visible
• UI: no Country filter / By country tab (single-market pack)
• Map tab: OpenStreetMap tiles (need internet; no map-service key); hover shows dealer total score vs the Israel LCV national average (and the delta in percentage points)
• Network average charts still use the full IDS 2026 network as an anonymous benchmark (no other dealer names)

(IDS follow-up owner on 26 summary: Jerome Van Der Pluym)

Double-click OPEN_IDS_2026_Israel_LCV.cmd to open the HTML.

Kind regards,
Jérôme Van der Pluym
